title: Giant Bouncy Beach Ball
wikitext:
{{Exclusive|Year/Seal}} {{Infobox/Item |rarity=l |source=[[Fishing]] |auctionable=no |id = GIANT_BOUNCY_BEACH_BALL |bazaar=GIANT_BOUNCY_BEACH_BALL }} A '''Giant Bouncy Beach Ball''' is a {{Legendary}} item obtained from fishing. It is used to start a version of the {{Item|Bouncy Beach Ball}} minigame where multiple players can bounce the ball to earn {{Item|Fishy Treat}}s. == Obtaining == A '''Giant Bouncy Beach Ball''' can be obtained while {{Skill|Fishing}} anywhere during the [[Year of the Seal]]. It has a {{Chance|15%|1|6.66}} chance to replace a {{Mctxt|bold=true|6|GREAT CATCH}} or {{Mctxt|bold=true|6|GREAT}} {{Mctxt|bold=true|2|JUNK}} {{Mctxt|bold=true|6|CATCH}}. {| class="wikitable centertext" ! Treasure Chance ! Catch Chance |- | {{Stat|Treasure Chance|5|icononly=y}} | {{Green|0.075%}}
({{Green|1}} in {{Green|1,333.3}}) |- | {{Stat|Treasure Chance|15|icononly=y}} | {{Green|0.225%}}
({{Green|1}} in {{Green|444.4}}) |- | {{Stat|Treasure Chance|30|icononly=y}} | {{Green|0.45%}}
({{Green|1}} in {{Green|222.2}}) |} When caught, the '''Giant Bouncy Beach Ball''' grants {{Skill XP|+300 Fishing}}. == Usage == A '''Giant Bouncy Beach Ball''' can be used to start a minigame where the player must bounce the '''Giant Bouncy Beach Ball''' off their head or other player's heads as many times as possible within {{Green|60}} seconds. A '''Giant Bouncy Beach Ball''' cannot be used on the {{zone|Private Island}}, {{zone|The Garden}} or the {{zone|Crystal Hollows}}. == Calculation == {{Sectionstub|Needs information on other numbers of participating players (up to 60).}} The player who launched the '''Giant Bouncy Beach Ball''' receives a number of {{Item|Fishy Treat}}s depending on the number of players who participated. Anyone else who participated receives {{Item|Fishy Treat|amount=1}}. {| class="wikitable centertext" ! Participants ! Fishy Treats |- | 0–1 | 5 |- | 2–4 | 9 |- | 5–7 | 12 |- | 8–14 | 15 |- | 15+ | {{Infoneeded}} |} == Game Messages == {{Sectionstub|Add text strings that occur at different numbers of bounces achieved, as well as their exact ranges.}} {{DialogueGrammar}} {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Associated Text |- |When initially using the item |{{Dialogue|&6&lBOUNCE BONANZA EX! &r&eKeep the &6Giant Bouncy Beach Ball &ein the air for &a60 seconds &eby bouncing it on your and other players heads!}} |- |After achieving a low amount of bounces in a row |{{Dialogue|&f&lDECENT! &r&6The Giant Bouncy Beach Ball was kept in the air for &a<#> &6bounces and &5<#> &6unique players have participated, rewarding you with &9<#> &6extra &9Fishy Treats&6!}} |- |When attempting to use on disallowed island |{{Dialogue|&cYou can't use this here!}} |} == Trivia == *The theoretical maximum amount of bounces for a '''Giant Bouncy Beach Ball''' is {{Green|1,200}}. **Minecraft runs {{Green|20}} game ticks per second and the '''Giant Bouncy Beach Ball''' has a {{Green|60}} second time limit. == See also == *{{Item|Bouncy Beach Ball}} == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2025/Feb 6|[[File:Giant Bouncy Beach Ball.png|26px]] Added '''Giant Bouncy Beach Ball'''.}} |beta= {{History|0.21.3|[[File:Giant Bouncy Beach Ball.png|26px]] Added '''Giant Bouncy Beach Ball'''.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Yearly Events System}} [[Category:Year of the Seal]]
